policy.title: Policies & Terms
policy.subtitle: Clear rules so you can hand us your laundry with peace of mind.

sections.title: Terms of service
items: Please check your pockets and remove cash, documents and valuables before handing over your laundry. We are not responsible for items left inside.
The final weight and price are based on the actual weight measured at pickup. Prices shown on the website are for reference only.
Items that may fade, shrink or have no care label will be discussed with you before cleaning.
The expected washing time of each service is listed on the Price list page and may be longer on peak days.

sections.title: Compensation policy
items: Please check your laundry and tell us within 24 hours of receiving it if anything is missing, lost or damaged.
Our fault: we clean it again for free. If it cannot be fixed, we compensate up to 10 times the service fee of that item.
Compensation does not cover damage caused by fabric quality, accessories (buttons, zippers, rhinestones) or stains and tears that existed before pickup.

sections.title: Payment
items: Pay in cash or by bank transfer when you receive your laundry.
Discounts (weight discount, loyalty points, promotions) are deducted directly from the amount to pay.
All fees are announced in advance, with no hidden charges.

sections.title: Cancellation and changes
items: Orders waiting for confirmation can be cancelled for free in "My orders" or via the hotline.
Once the shipper has picked up your laundry, the order cannot be cancelled on the website. Please call the hotline for help.
To change the pickup time, please call the hotline or message us in the chat.

sections.title: Privacy
items: Your name, phone number and address are only used for pickup, delivery and customer care.
We never sell or share your personal data with third parties, unless required by law.
You can ask us to edit or delete your personal data at any time via the hotline or email.
